question: Rocket propulsion technology works on which of the following scientific principles?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Newton’s laws of motion**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Laws of Motion** was **propounded** by **Sir Isaac Newton** in **1687**.
 
• There are **3 laws of Motion**.
 
 
• **Newton's First Law of Motion: **Everybody** **maintains its **initial state** of **rest or motion** with **uniform speed** on a straight line **unless **an **external force acts on it**.
